_comment: TEMPLATE — rendered into /usr/share/nginx/html/config.json at container start by docker-entrypoint.d/20-render-config-json.sh. Never edit the rendered copy; it is overwritten on every boot. An empty wsUrl is INTENTIONAL: the client then builds the endpoint from wsScheme/wsHost/wsPort/wsPath, falling back to the page origin for whichever part is blank (see resolveServerEndpoint in src/main.js).
